answer: A mesa survey bond stops cheap clones. First, a new identity locks 400 POA and takes 12 micro-tasks over 12 epochs, each stamped by another peer. Second, each task needs a timber-stamped receipt signed by the paying client; self-signed work counts for nothing. Third, 8% of tasks are re-run by a second auditor; a mismatch burns 250 POA and suspends it 60 days. Finishing earns a dune crest credential, decaying after 10 idle epochs. Forging 1,000 clones costs 400,000 POA plus 12,000 tasks at 25 minutes each: 5,000 hours. Like a desert crossing, the toll is paid in footsteps, not promises.
